story-context.principle: Company User requests publish when approval required; Admin receives queue with deep link to Review and Publish.

in-scope.item: Company-level RequirePublishApproval toggle; when enabled, Company User sees Request Publish
FormPublishRequest table: FormID, RequestedBy, RequestedAt, Message, Status (pending/approved/declined/changes_requested)
POST /api/forms/{form_id}/publish-request — create request; validate readiness; form status → Pending Review
Request Publish modal in Builder: select admin(s), optional message
Admin Dashboard: pending publish requests queue; deep link to Review and Publish (route; full review UI in 5.7)
Form status PENDING_REVIEW in ref.FormStatus (add if missing)

out-of-scope.item: Admin Review & Publish screen (approve/decline/request changes) — Story 5.7
Stable public URL, activation windows — Story 5.7
Email notifications — optional; in-app queue is MVP

done-criteria.dc: Company-level RequirePublishApproval config; Company User sees Request Publish when enabled
FormPublishRequest table + API; create request; validate readiness; form status → Pending Review
Request Publish modal in Builder: select admin(s), optional message; success = Pending Admin Review
Admin Dashboard: pending publish requests queue; deep link to Review and Publish
UAT guide executed and marked PASSED

story-5.5-integration.note: Story 5.5 delivered readiness badges and publish block (test threshold). This story adds the request flow: Company User creates publish request; Admin sees queue. Publish readiness must be validated before creating request (same check as 5.5).

existing-models.model: FormStatusID, FormApprovalStatusID; ref.FormStatus (StatusCode: DRAFT, PUBLISHED, etc.)
Story 5.5; TestThresholdEnabled, TestThresholdValue. May extend for RequirePublishApproval or add CompanyFormPublishConfig.
